svg.title: The mask as a table, on 12 characters of a line of the test text: 0 where a row may look, -inf above the diagonal; and the weights of the page's trained model (seed 0) after the softmax, exactly 0 above the diagonal
svg.text: added to the scores: the mask
row i: the position that asks; column j: the position it looks at; _ is a space.
Each row of weights adds up to 1 over the positions it may see; the first row's 1 is all on itself.
